column4: The same tall stained-glass window and the same serene icon of the girl, same pose, arms low and open, palms up. Change one thing: her face, neck and hands are made of separate pieces of stained glass exactly like her dress — about five to seven large panes per face, each joined by a thick coal lead came as bold as the leads in the dress. The leads run along natural lines: one across the forehead under the bangs, one down beside the nose, one across the cheek, one along the jaw; eyes and mouth stay whole inside their panes and readable. No thin hairline cracks or crazing anywhere — only clean, bold, deliberate lead lines.

The same three side stained-glass windows with the same three poses of the girl. Change one thing: in each window her face and hands are made of a few large stained-glass panes joined by thick coal lead lines as bold as those in her dress (across the forehead, beside the nose, across the cheek); eyes stay whole and readable. No thin hairline cracks.
